create_xgrammar_backend: create an XGrammarGrammarBackend instance with a tokenizer, vocab size, and optional EOS token IDs
dispatch_json_schema: dispatch a JSON schema string to compile a constrained grammar using XGrammarGrammarBackend
dispatch_ebnf_grammar: dispatch an EBNF grammar string to compile a constrained grammar using XGrammarGrammarBackend
dispatch_regex_grammar: dispatch a regex pattern string to compile a constrained grammar using XGrammarGrammarBackend
dispatch_structural_tag: dispatch a structural tag JSON string to compile a constrained grammar using XGrammarGrammarBackend
accept_token_constrained: accept a token in a compiled XGrammarGrammar and validate it against the grammar constraints
rollback_grammar_state: rollback a grammar matcher state by k tokens and trim accepted tokens list
apply_vocab_mask_logits: apply a vocabulary bitmask to logits tensor to constrain token selection on supported devices
